business_problem: Happiest Minds wanted users of its Digital Content Monetization platform to find and act on information buried in large unstructured repositories more quickly, because keyword-based search only returned matching paragraphs and limited decision speed and customer value.
solution_summary: Happiest Minds worked with IBM on a proof of concept that loaded unstructured repository data into IBM watsonx.ai on IBM Cloud so the company could replace exact-match lookup with AI-assisted retrieval and summarization. In the DCM platform, watsonx.ai is used to search across large collections of content, identify the most relevant passages through retrieval-augmented generation, and then summarize and rephrase the results for end users interacting through chat. That approach lets the platform turn a broad document search problem into a pointed-answer experience, which is important for a product with more than 50 catalog features and multiple downstream dashboards and business charts. The same RAG pattern also speeds internal content curation, because relevant material is surfaced faster and can be repackaged into insight views without the manual hunting and rewriting that previously slowed teams down. The solution is still being tuned through internal and beta testing, but it already gives Happiest Minds a repeatable architecture for conversational access to its content estate.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.ai
solution_components.role: Drives the RAG-based search, answer generation, and summarization workflows across the content repositories.

solution_components.name: IBM Cloud
solution_components.role: Hosts the watsonx.ai environment used to serve the DCM platform’s AI-assisted search experience.

data_flow: Unstructured content from the DCM platform is loaded into watsonx.ai on IBM Cloud, relevant documents are retrieved through RAG, the selected passages are summarized and rephrased for chat interactions, and the curated outputs feed dashboards, charts, and decision support inside the platform.
business_outcome: Happiest Minds increased productivity, reduced the time needed to create business charts, and gave customers a faster, more accurate way to retrieve content insights through natural-language interaction.
metrics: reduced the time required to create business charts by 15 hours per feature per month
architecture_clues: The proof of concept loaded unstructured data into a Prompt Lab in watsonx.ai.
RAG components identify relevant documents before LLM summarization.
The company plans more internal and beta testing before broader production release.
